name: jev-codex-router
description: Install and operate Auto (Jev), a local model router designed for Codex GPT-6 Luna, Sol, and Astra.

interface.shortDescription: Set up Auto (Jev) for Codex GPT-6 models.
interface.longDescription: Designed for Codex GPT-6 Luna, Sol, and Astra. Guides installation of a local Codex Router and Jev decision service. Installing this plugin does not start local services or configure credentials.
defaultPrompt: Help me install Auto (Jev) for Codex without exposing my credentials.
Diagnose why Auto (Jev) is not routing a request.
